department: School of Medicine, basic biomedical sciences core

deadline.value: Apply by Feb. 1 for assistantship consideration; the Pharmacology core also takes applications by Feb. 1 and Anatomy uses March 1.
deadline.quote: For priority consideration for graduate assistantship, apply by Feb. 1

also.quote: Students must submit an application to the Core Graduate Program by Feb. 1

gre_general.value: The core asks for 'sufficient GRE scores' with no set minimum; the Anatomy PhD sets GRE General at the 40th percentile (its own page).
gre_general.quote: Students should possess an above-average GPA, sufficient GRE scores and TOEFL scores (for international students)

app_fee.value: The School of Medicine application lists a fee, but no amount appears on the fetched catalog page.

supervisor.value: Students rotate through labs in the first year and choose a dissertation mentor later, so no supervisor is needed for admission.
supervisor.quote: before selecting a dissertation mentor and specializing within biochemistry and molecular biology

funding.value: Assistantships are offered on a priority-deadline basis; the page does not promise funding to every admitted student.
funding.quote: For priority consideration for graduate assistantship, apply by Feb. 1

entry_route.value: Students entering with a bachelor's degree start with a common yearlong core.
entry_route.quote: Students entering with a bachelor’s degree complete a common, yearlong basic biomedical sciences core

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test applies to this field, and the page does not mention one.

notes: Covers the School of Medicine basic-science core. Its PhDs in Molecular Microbiology and Immunology (catalog page under medicine/biomedical-science), Pharmacology and Physiological Science (same folder) and Anatomy (medicine/anatomy) share the core but have their own pages; Anatomy requires GRE General at the 40th percentile and asks for applications by March 1.
name: Biomedical Sciences PhD (School of Medicine core)
